description: Web-based sales CRM and pipeline management software
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 auth code for public Marketplace apps; stateless API tokens obtained manually from the Pipedrive app for private/personal use.

api_notes: Comprehensive RESTful API covering deals, leads, organizations, persons, activities, pipelines, filters, webhooks, and more.
mcp_notes: Pipedrive provides official capabilities/mention (e.g. Pipedrive MCP listed on features and pipedeive-skills repository on GitHub).
